column1: 20796§congregate§ˈkɒŋɡrɪɡeɪt§Reindeer once congregated on these icy patches in the later summer months to escape biting insects.§在夏末的几个月里，驯鹿曾**聚集**在这些冰面上，以躲避昆虫的叮咬。§
20797§ensue§ɪnˈsjuː§If a forest fire cannot be extinguished, devastation is sure to ensue.§如果不能扑灭森林火灾，毁坏一定会**随之发生**。§
20798§instruct§ɪnˈstrʌkt§PE teachers instruct students how to exercise, play sports, and do other recreational activities correctly and safely.§体育老师**指导**学生们如何安全正确地锻炼、做运动以及进行其他娱乐活动。§
20799§declaration§ˌdekləˈreɪʃn§This declaration seemed to calm the discontented party members somewhat.§这项**声明**似乎让那些心存不满的党派成员稍微平静了点。§

20800§flexibility§ˌfleksəˈbɪləti§PE teachers help the development of coordination, balance, posture, and flexibility with activities like simple catching and throwing.§体育老师利用简单抓取和投掷等活动帮助学生发展身体的协调性、平衡性以及改善他们的体态和**柔韧性**。§

20801§native§ˈneɪtɪv§All teachers in this school have specialist qualifications in teaching English to foreign students, and are all native speakers.§这所学校所有的老师都具备教外籍学生英语的专业资格，且均为英语**母语**人士。§改译文：native speakers 不是「英语国家人士」，改为「英语母语人士」
20802§significant§sɪgˈnɪfɪkənt§Modifications to houses come at a significant cost to the home buyers.§房屋改造对购房人来说是一笔**不菲**的开销。§
20803§loyalty§ˈlɔɪəlti§Trade discounts may be used as a competitive stratagem to secure customer loyalty.§商业折扣可以用作保持顾客**忠诚度**的一种竞争策略。§
20804§conditioner§kənˈdɪʃənə(r)§If your hair is dry in winter, you can use some hair conditioner every day.§如果你的头发在冬天时比较干燥，你可以每天用一些**护发素**。§
20805§reduce§rɪˈdjuːs§Catastrophes such as fire, flood, drought or epidemic may reduce population sizes to a small fraction of their average level.§火灾、洪水、旱灾或流行病之类的大灾难可能会**降低**人口数量，使其远远低于正常水平。§
20806§controversy§ˈkɒntrəvɜːsi§There exists a controversy over the plan for a new teaching building.§建造新教学楼的计划存在**争议**。§
20807§service§ˈsɜːvɪs§The airline companies want to improve the service.§航空公司想提升**服务**质量。§
20808§dwell§dwel§This kind of ground-dwelling herbivore may go extinct within a decade.§这种地**栖**食草动物也许在十年内就会灭绝。§
20809§sensation§senˈseɪʃn§This discovery would cause not much more sensation than Herschel's discovery of Uranus, in 1781.§这一发现的影响不会比赫歇尔于1781年首次发现天王星时更**轰动**。§

20810§scrap§skræp§Scrapping farm-price support and protection for coal-mining offers a two-fold bonus: a cleaner environment and a more efficient economy.§**废除**农产品价格补贴和对采煤业的保护有双重好处，可以获得更清洁的环境和更高效的经济。§
20811§anxious§ˈæŋkʃəs§He is anxious to enter the competition.§他**急切**希望能加入比赛。§
20812§recipient§rɪˈsɪpiənt§This artificial heart recipient will recover in three weeks.§人造心脏**接受者**将在三个星期后康复。§
20813§identical§aɪˈdentɪkl§Even among identical twins, one in six pairs will differ in their handedness.§即使是**同卵**双胞胎，平均六对中也会出现一对在使用左右手习惯上不同的双胞胎。§
20814§rival§ˈraɪvl§The rival team lost by 12 points in the first round.§第一轮比赛中，**对手**队以12分之差败北。§
20815§tropospheric§ˌtrɒpəˈsferɪk§Scientists measured tropospheric ozone levels above the city to assess the impact of traffic emissions on air quality.§科学家测量了城市上空**对流层**臭氧的含量，以评估交通排放对空气质量的影响。§补例句
20816§attraction§əˈtrækʃn§The attraction of single-speed cycles is their simplicity and reliability.§单速自行车**吸引人之处**在于其简单性和可靠性。§
20817§earthwork§ˈɜːθwɜːk§Some contemporary tribes still live among the earthworks of earlier cultures.§一些现存的部落依然生活在早期文化的**土垒建筑**里。§
20818§surround§səˈraʊnd§For the most part, we breathe in the aromas which surround us without being consciously aware of their importance to us.§大多数时候，我们呼吸着**周围**的香气，却没有意识到它们对我们的重要性。§
20819§impression§ɪmˈpreʃn§Could you tell us something about your first impression of the town when you arrived?§你能不能告诉我当你初到这个小镇时，你的第一**印象**是什么？§
20820§horrify§ˈhɒrɪfaɪ§I had been horrified by several newspaper reports.§我对几篇新闻报道的内容感到**震惊**。§
20821§introduction§ˌɪntrəˈdʌkʃn§By way of introduction, I shall give you the background of the subject.§通过**介绍**，我将向你讲述该学科的相关背景。§
20822§compact§kəmˈpækt§The bag must be compact and light for easy transport.§这个包必须**小巧**轻便以便于运输。§改译文：compact 不是「结实」，改为「小巧轻便」
20823§enquire§ɪnˈkwaɪə(r)§If you have any question, you are welcome to call the Students' Union to enquire.§有任何问题，欢迎致电学生会**询问**。§改例句：welcome to call 缺主语，应为 you are welcome to call
20824§memorandum§ˌmeməˈrændəm§The manager circulated a memorandum to all staff outlining the new procedures for booking annual leave.§经理向全体员工分发了一份**备忘录**，概述了申请年假的新流程。§补例句
20825§rectangular§rekˈtæŋgjələ(r)§In front of the Empire State Building is a long rectangular wading pool.§帝国大厦前面是一个**长方形**的浅水池。§
20826§kidney§ˈkɪdni§The doctor asked Mark whether he had ever suffered from any liver, kidney or heart disease.§医生问马克以前是否得过肝、**肾**或是心脏方面的疾病。§
20827§standpoint§ˈstændpɔɪnt§From a completely economical standpoint, the ad is actually more important than the film itself.§单以经济学**观点**看，这则广告实际上比电影本身更重要。§
20828§curative§ˈkjʊərətɪv§Researchers are investigating whether the plant has any curative effect on common skin conditions.§研究人员正在调查这种植物对常见皮肤病是否有**疗效**。§补例句
20829§predominantly§prɪˈdɒmɪnəntli§Tom grew up in the predominantly black, middle-class suburb of this city.§汤姆在这个城市黑人和中产阶级**占多数**的市郊长大。§
20830§clutch§klʌtʃ§The driver released the clutch to engage the gears and make his car go.§司机松开**离合器**，挂上挡，这样汽车就开动起来了。§
20831§combine§kəmˈbaɪn§The next step was to combine the holder with a small camera.§下一步是将支架和一台小型相机**连接**起来。§
20832§chart§tʃɑːt§The first chart shows the reasons why adults decide to study.§第一张**图表**显示成年人决定进行学习的原因。§

20833§asthma§ˈæsmə§A world-wide rise in asthma over the past four decades is said to be linked with increased air pollution.§据说，在过去的40年里，世界范围内**哮喘病**发病率升高与越来越严重的空气污染有关。§改例句：主语 A world-wide rise in asthma over the past four decades 中间多了一个逗号，把主语和谓语隔开了，删去
20834§signature§ˈsɪgnətʃə(r)§Corbett ran into the bedroom and scribbled his signature on the notebook.§科比特冲进卧室，在笔记本上潦草地签上了自己的**名字**。§
20835§occasion§əˈkeɪʒn§It should have been an occasion for rejoicing, but she could not feel any real joy.§原本应该是高兴的**时刻**，她却丝毫未感到真正的快乐。§
20836§invaluable§ɪnˈvæljuəbl§The library's online database proved invaluable to students who were writing their final-year research projects.§事实证明，图书馆的在线数据库对正在写毕业研究课题的学生**极其有用**。§补例句
20837§recover§rɪˈkʌvə(r)§After a few days of cough, my roommate began to recover.§咳嗽了几天后，我的室友开始**康复**了。§
20838§moderation§ˌmɒdəˈreɪʃn§In the middle of Health Diet Pyramid we find the things that we can eat in moderation.§我们可以**适量**吃处于健康饮食金字塔中部的食物。§
20839§documentation§ˌdɒkjumenˈteɪʃn§When you open a bank account, you should take some documentation with you.§当你去银行开户时，要随身携带一些**证明资料**。§
20840§critical§ˈkrɪtɪkl§The strike has been stopped, but the situation is still critical at the moment.§虽然罢工停止了，但是当前形势仍很**危急**。§
20841§vocational§vəʊˈkeɪʃənl§This is a vocational training institute.§这是一家**职业**培训机构。§
20842§summary§ˈsʌməri§Tina gave a summary of the activity last night.§蒂娜昨晚给出了活动的**概要**。§
20843§remove§rɪˈmuːv§Water soluble vitamins are removed rapidly from the body.§水溶性维生素可以很快**排出**体外。§
20844§bound§baʊnd§Because these courses start every Monday, there's bound to be one that fits in with your academic, personal or professional commitments.§因为这些课程每周一都开，所以**一定**有适合你学习、针对你个人或工作内容的课程。§
20845§trinket§ˈtrɪŋkɪt§The lady had some trinkets on her dress.§这位女士在衣服上挂了一些**饰品**。§
20846§expire§ɪkˈspaɪə(r)§The lease on this house expires at the end of the year.§这房子租约年底**到期**。§
20847§accessible§əkˈsesəbl§He pointed his telescope to every accessible part of the sky and recorded what he saw.§他将望远镜指向天空中所有**可以达到**的地方，并记录下所看到的。§
20848§turbine§ˈtɜːbaɪn§Ultraclean coal can be used in advanced power systems such as coal-fired gas turbines.§超纯煤可以用在诸如燃煤的燃气**涡轮机**之类的先进动力系统中。§
20849§backbone§ˈbækbəʊn§The Ottawa Charter for Health Promotion outlined in 1986 remains as the backbone of health action today.§1986年起草的《渥太华健康促进宪章》仍是今天健康活动的**支柱**。§
20850§attribute§əˈtrɪbjuːt§The global increase in greenhouse gases has been largely attributed to industrial pollution in developed countries.§全球温室气体的增加主要**归咎于**发达国家的工业污染。§
20851§magnitude§ˈmægnɪtjuːd§Stargazers were struck by the uncommon magnitude of the newly discovered comet.§这颗新发现的彗星尤其**亮**，令天文学家们非常吃惊。§
20852§compatible§kəmˈpætəbl§Accuracy is not always compatible with haste.§准确与匆忙难以**兼容**，忙中难免出错。§改译文：原译“忙中难免出错。”是意译，没有和 compatible 对应的词，前面补“准确与匆忙难以兼容，”
20853§entrepreneur§ˌɒntrəprəˈnɜː(r)§The owner of the company is an American entrepreneur.§这家公司的老板是一位美国**企业家**。§
20854§proposal§prəˈpəʊzl§The school master has accepted proposals to renovate the old schoolhouses.§校长已经接受了翻新旧校舍的**提议**。§
20855§coach§kəʊtʃ§They play just as important a role as the coach in our team.§在我们队里，他们扮演着和**教练**同等重要的角色。§
20856§tramp§træmp§Those poor people tramped for miles and miles without finding anywhere to stay.§那些可怜的人**走啊走**，始终找不到栖身之处。§
20857§fatal§ˈfeɪtl§The majority of single-gene defects are fatal.§大部分的单基因缺陷都是**致命**的。§
20858§currency§ˈkʌrənsi§The demand for foreign currency depreciates the real value of local currencies.§对外币的需求降低了当地**货币**的实际价值。§
20859§disapprove§ˌdɪsəˈpruːv§They disapprove of paying farmers who have not cultivated the land.§他们**不赞成**付钱给未耕种土地的农民。§
20860§complain§kəmˈpleɪn§John complains that the resource centre has limited opening hours.§约翰**抱怨**说信息中心的开放时间有限。§
20861§audacious§ɔːˈdeɪʃəs§The audacious proposal was quickly denied by the committee.§这个**冒险的**提议很快就被委员会否决了。§
20862§disrupt§dɪsˈrʌpt§Work of any company may be disrupted by absence of its employees.§任何一家公司的工作都可能因员工的旷工而**中断**。§
20863§inflation§ɪnˈfleɪʃn§Inflation reduced the purchasing power of the families.§**通货膨胀**降低了家庭的购买力。§
